text:
Hey Yaniv - I completely understand the frustration, especially when you feel like you're doing everything right and just not getting a response :( 

That said, while two months without a response certainly feels like a long time, from what we see across the community it's unfortunately relatively normal. Average response times tend to be around three months, and some offices take shorter or longer (I know of people here who are waiting 6 months, though that is unusual). So while I know that's not what you want to hear, your case is still below the average processing time, and isn't necessarily stuck or being ignored.

If you do want to take action, you could submit a formal complaint to PIBA's public complaints email at tz@piba.gov.il. That said, I would recommend giving it a little more time before going that route. Sometimes a complaint filed too early can just add noise rather than speed things up.
